Kevin Trudeau tells the story of how one genetically modified tomato actually gets made.

His claim: scientists took a pig gene and put it inside the tomato seed itself, so the plant wards off a bug on its own, without a spray.

Then, he says, they took the weed poison from Monsanto and built that into the seed too, so it comes up from inside the plant instead of being sprayed on top.

His point: nature already made a working tomato. Science just patented a new one to sell.
